title: Electrolytes, Sports Drinks, and Sugar-Free Hydration
lessons: The player first considers Liquid I.V. because the brand claims its hydration formulas provide more electrolytes than a leading sports drink.
The player likes the format but has switched from the original formula to a sugar-free Hydration Multiplier.

text: The player first considers Liquid I.V. because the brand claims its hydration formulas provide more electrolytes than a leading sports drink.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Three times the electrolytes sounds very specific.

entry-first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: It is specific. The comparison is against the leading sports drink.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So that is the claim I should actually evaluate, not just more hydration in giant letters.

entry-first-4.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Exactly. Read the comparison before you let the headline do all the work.

choice-first.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like knowing what the product is trying to do.
I want to know what that comparison actually means.
I do not need a performance claim after every workout.

first-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Good. Function is the reason I get invited into the gym bag.

first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: You should read the ingredients and the comparison, especially if sodium or sugar matters to you.

first-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Fair. Plenty of workouts end successfully with water.
The player likes the format but has switched from the original formula to a sugar-free Hydration Multiplier.

entry-return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: You kept the stick. You changed the formula.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I liked the convenience. I did not want the sugar.

entry-return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then Sugar-Free is the cleaner answer for your preference.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Same little ritual, less arguing with the label.

entry-return-5.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: That is the kind of boring compatibility I like.

choice-return.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that I did not have to leave the brand to change that.
I still want to know what sweetener I am drinking.
I would rather skip flavored hydration entirely.

return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Exactly. If the sugar-free one fits you better, use that one.

return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then read it. Sugar-free is not the same thing as ingredient-free.

return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: That is a real option too. I do not need to win every bottle of water.
